messages.subject: [rkward-users] rkward installation
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Mon, 3 Aug 2015 09:28:21 -0600
David Stevens <david.stevens at usu.edu> wrote:
> All - just today I went through installation of KDE and rkward on a
> Lenovo Windows 7 laptop and when I try to start rkward, I crash with
> the message

[_ZN7QString16fromAscii_helperEPKci could not be located]

> Where do I go next?

My best guess at this point is that you used the "custom installation"
procedure, and somehow the version of KDE you installed is not
compatible with the one required by RKWard (there could be several
causes of this). Before anything else, please

- Reboot your system
- Remove/Rename your existing RKWard installation
- Install RKWard using the "Installation bundle"
- Start RKWard.exe inside that installation

Verify that this works.

messages.subject: [rkward-users] feedback needed: future OS X releases of RKWard
messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] feedback needed: future OS X releases of RKWard
messages.body_plain:
hi,

until now, we were able to offer RKWard package bundles for OS X >= 10.7. this 
OS X release is no longer supported by apple and we have to upgrade our build 
environment. in theory, an upgrade to 10.8 would be possible, but in practice, 
apple's app store doesn't offer upgrades to 10.8 or 10.9 any longer. 

upgrading to 10.10 (yosemite) would be possible, which would also make the 
development easier, since we wouldn't have to care for compatibility with 
several old releases for the time being. but it would also mean that the 
resulting bundles would require the same OS X version (or higher) as a minimum 
requirement. 

according to this source, the market share of yosemite already reached 62% of 
all OS X installations (10.9: 17%; 10.8: 5%):
http://www.netmarketshare.com/operating-system-market-share.aspx?qprid=10&qpcustomd=0&qpsp=198&qpnp=1&qptimeframe=M

we would like to find out if it would mean too much of a drawback for RKWard 
if future releases would only be available for OS X >= 10.10, which seems like 
our preferred alternative -- what's your opinion on this?


viele grüße :: m.eik

-- 
  dipl. psych. meik michalke
  institut f"ur experimentelle psychologie
  abt. f"ur diagnostik und differentielle psychologie
  heinrich-heine-universit"at d-40204 d"usseldorf
